subtitle: Space memory drills
promotional_text: Build missions of space facts, anchor each one to a picture you can't forget, then drill your weakest cues first. Grade yourself and watch the ring fill. Private, offline.
description: Orbit Recall is an offline memory-training deck for space and science class. Build missions around one topic, file cues with an anchor picture, then drill the weakest cues first and grade yourself. Recall levels, progress rings, a starred drill deck and a flight log — all stored on your phone, with no account and no network calls.
app_review_notes: Offline memory-training app for astronomy topics. Create missions, file cues with an anchor note, and run flashcard drills. No sign-in, no network calls. Camera and photo library are optional and only used when attaching a picture to a cue.
